text:
maria: Quick heads-up — FinRegCo just asked if our POC can guarantee that all inference and logs stay in EU for the trial. Also wants list of subprocessors and an estimate for a 2-week dedicated POC cost. Any blockers?

alex: We can run the POC in eu-west-1 and pin the model to a regional replica. Need to confirm their KMS preference (our KMS vs BYOK). Are they okay with Redwood-managed KMS for the short POC?

maria: They prefer customer-managed KMS if possible, but said they'd accept Redwood-managed for a short evaluation if we document subprocessors and network path.

tim: Technical note — we support regional pinning + tenant affinity. For strict residency we route inference and KV cache to eu nodes only and set egress=deny for non-eu targets. Fallback behavior defaults to model-variant in same region (no cross-region).

  Example routing snippet I use for POCs:

  ```
  routing: 
    region_preference: [eu-west-1]
    failover: none 
    egress_policy: BLOCK_NON_EU 
    kms: customer-provided-or-redwood
  ```

alex: Will also call out subprocessors: cloud infra (major cloud provider eu region), metrics/observability (SaaS in eu), and a monitoring pager duty integration. Sarah can confirm legal wording.

sarah: For questionnaires — we can provide the subprocessor list and SCCs/RSA. For BYOK we need lead time (usually 3 business days for onboarding + key exchange steps). If they need a contractual DPA addendum for the POC, we can do a short-term amendment.

maria: Perfect. Pricing question — they asked for a ballpark: 2-week dedicated GPU pool (small), plus throughput for 10k requests/day, with retention off.

alex: Ballpark numbers (subject to final sizing):
- Dedicated POC base fee: €3,000/week for a small reserved slot (includes 8 vCPU equivalent / 1x A10-ish GPU)
- Token compute estimate: ~€0.005 per 1k tokens (preview price) — for their volume expect ~€400–€800 total for 2 weeks
- BYOK onboarding: one-time €500 ops fee if they want customer-managed KMS
Total approx: €7k–€8.5k for the 2-week POC. Mark with ~20% variance depending on model/seq len.

maria: Can you drop that in a short note I can send to the customer? I want to highlight no cross-border egress during POC, list of subprocessors, and the BYOK lead time.

alex: Copy I can send: "We can run the 2-week POC fully within EU (eu-west-1). No inference or logs will leave the region. Subprocessors for the POC are: cloud infra provider (EU region), monitoring vendor (EU), and Redwood internal telemetry (EU-hosted). BYOK supported with ~3 business days onboarding. Estimated POC cost: €7k–€8.5k. Let us know if you need a DPA addendum for the trial." Want me to send from my account or you?

maria: Send from you — they'll recognize you from the technical handoff. Add a short ops contact (tim) and legal (sarah).

deploy-bot: Checklist created: POC-EU-FINREG-1738001234 — tasks: spin regional pool, add subproc list to questionnaire, schedule BYOK exchange, enable egress block, validate telemetry retention. Assigned: alex, tim, sarah. ETA: 48h. :white_check_mark:

maria: Awesome, thanks. One last thing — customer asked if we can expose a simple header showing "region-processed: eu-west-1" in responses for audit. Any objections?

tim: No objections. We'll add response header and log a signed assertion for the session. Small change, ETA 1 day.

sarah: I'll prepare a one-page subprocessor + DPA note to attach.

maria: Great — I'll follow up with the customer after alex sends the note. :thumbsup:
